page.overview:
What is Upgrade?

Upgrade, known as Upgrade Sprite before Generation VIII, is an item introduced in Generation II.

Upgrade is an evolution item that, if held by Porygon during a trade, evolves it into Porygon2. After this, the Upgrade disappears.
